questions.question:
D2 — Issue 1 (Pass 1, Visual Hierarchy): make Save the single primary action?
Project/branch/task: main branch, PLAN.md design review, header action group.
ELI10: Right now Save, Reset, Cancel, and Export all look identical. A user scanning the header sees four equal grey buttons and has to read every label to find the one that stores their work. DESIGN.md already says Save is the only filled primary button and the other three are neutral ghost buttons. This just brings the implementation in line with that.
Stakes if we pick wrong: users hesitate at the one moment the journey needs confidence, and some hit Reset or Cancel by mistake next to Save.
Recommendation: 1A because DESIGN.md already prescribes the exact tokens and the change is one class swap per button.
Completeness: 1A=10/10, 1B=5/10, 1C=0/10
Net: a token-exact fix now versus leaving a documented hierarchy gap in the shipped header.

options.label: 1A) Save filled #1d4ed8/white, others ghost (recommended)
options.description: ✅ Matches DESIGN.md exactly: one filled primary, three neutral ghosts, 44px targets kept. (human: ~30min / CC: ~3min) ✅ White-on-#1d4ed8 text is about 8:1 contrast, well above AA. ❌ Ghost buttons must still show a visible border or the row loses its clickability signal.

options.label: 1B) Weight and size only, keep colors
options.description: ✅ Save stands out without touching the palette. ✅ Smallest visual delta from the current build. ❌ Contradicts DESIGN.md's filled-primary rule, so /design-review will flag it again later.

options.label: 1C) Decline, leave all four identical
options.description: ✅ Zero implementation work in this update. ✅ Nothing new to QA visually. ❌ Documented DESIGN.md violation ships and Pass 1 stays at 7/10.
